requirement.original: Fix 2 BashView scrollbar bugs: 1) Horizontal scrollbar appears before '+N more lines' text — hide it. 2) Bottom corners render ugly — add borderBottomLeftRadius/Right matching card border radius
requirement.clarified: Hide horizontal scrollbar in BashView inline preview and round bottom corners to 11px to match card design
requirement.why: Inline bash command preview has unwanted horizontal scrollbar and mismatched corner radius
success_criteria: Horizontal scrollbar not visible in inline preview
Bottom corners rounded to 11px matching card border radius
No visual regression in other aspects of BashView
constraints: Must maintain existing scroll behavior for content
Border radius must match existing card design (11px)

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Horizontal scrollbar visible in inline bash preview; bottom corners sharp instead of rounded
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: BashView missing showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false} and borderBottomLeftRadius/borderBottomRightRadius styles with overflow constraint
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Initial BashView implementation did not include full card styling polish
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Visual inconsistency: scrollbar appears before text; unpolished corners break card design

context.codebase_state: happy-dev monorepo with React Native UI components

development_approach.strategy: Apply minimal style fixes to BashView component
development_approach.validation_approach: Render inline bash preview in dev web UI, verify scrollbar hidden and corners rounded

research_findings.reason: Straightforward styling fix with clear requirements, no architectural decisions needed
